title: What if few take the offer?
hook: The treatment response stays fixed while the share taking the offer changes.

knows: arithmetic means, rates and simple plotted values
doesNotKnow: as compliance drops, the measured effect shrinks.

misconception: Treating not everyone takes the pill as valid without checking the stated model, denominators or causal assumptions.
objective: as compliance drops, the measured effect shrinks.
keyState: Both finite cases completed; their computed summaries retained.

claims.text: A treatment adds 10 for every complier, and an offer changes nothing else. If only 20% take it up, what mean effect does assignment have?
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-not-everyone-takes-the-pill/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Treatment effect among compliers10, take-up share.2,.5,.8. Assignment effect2,5,8 under exclusion and no defiers. Vary take-up and show effect diluted, not treatment becoming weaker.

claims.text: The 20% case retains assignment effect 2; the 80% case retains 8. The stipulated complier effect stays 10 in both cases.
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-not-everyone-takes-the-pill/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Treatment effect among compliers10, take-up share.2,.5,.8. claims.text: The offer affects only those whose treatment receipt changes, so lower uptake dilutes the population-average assignment effect. Dividing by uptake needs the exclusion and compliance assumptions; it does not automatically identify effects for people who never comply.
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-not-everyone-takes-the-pill/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Treatment effect among compliers10, take-up share.2,.5,.8. Assignment effect2,5,8 under exclusion and no defiers. Vary take-up and show effect diluted, not treatment becoming weaker.

claims.text: Complier effect is 12 and uptake is 50%, with no direct offer effect. What is assignment effect? Half the assigned population receives a gain of 12, producing an average gain of 6.
